intent.raw_query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026

experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Spend a full day hopping between the stunning Phi Phi islands by speedboat, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters at Maya Bay, exploring Viking Cave, and relaxing on pristine white-sand beaches. Lunch is typically included and guides point out colorful marine life along the way.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Walk in Yaowarat
experiences.description: Dive into Bangkok's legendary Chinatown street food scene after dark. Sample pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, oyster omelets, and fresh seafood from bustling roadside stalls. Join a guided food walk or explore independently along the neon-lit Yaowarat Road for an authentic local experience.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunset Beach Kayaking
experiences.description: Paddle a sea kayak through calm turquoise waters along Koh Lanta's quieter western coastline, exploring hidden sea caves and mangrove channels. Time your paddle to catch the spectacular Andaman Sea sunset from the water, then enjoy fresh grilled fish at a beachside shack afterward.
experiences.location: Klong Dao Beach, Koh Lanta, Krabi Province

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Street Food & Night Bazaar Experience
experiences.description: Wander through Chiang Mai's famous Saturday or Sunday Walking Street and Night Bazaar, tasting northern Thai specialties like khao soi (coconut curry noodle soup), sai oua (herb sausage), and crispy pork rinds. Interact with local vendors, browse handmade crafts, and soak in the vibrant cultural atmosphere unique to northern Thailand.
experiences.location: Wualai Walking Street & Night Bazaar, Chiang Mai Old City

experiences.name: Similan Islands Full-Day Snorkeling Expedition
experiences.description: Board a day-trip boat from Khao Lak to the world-renowned Similan Islands National Park, considered one of the top snorkeling and diving destinations on the planet. Swim alongside sea turtles, reef sharks, and vibrant coral gardens at multiple snorkel stops, hike to a scenic viewpoint, and relax on powdery white beaches. National park entry fee and equipment rental included.
experiences.location: Similan Islands National Park, Phang Nga Province

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Thailand
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30. Clear customs and immigration, collect baggage. Take the Airport Rail Link (45 THB) or a metered taxi (~300-400 THB) to your accommodation area. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort and settle in.

meals.breakfast: On the plane
meals.lunch: On the plane
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack from a 7-Eleven convenience store near the airport or hotel (budget ~50-80 THB) — Thailand's 7-Elevens are famous for affordable hot meals, sandwiches, and snacks.

day_by_day.notes: Exchange some currency at the airport (look for SuperRich or Vasu exchange booths for better rates). Get a local SIM card at the airport (AIS or DTAC, ~300 THB for 30 days of data). Don't over-exchange — ATMs are widely available. Rest up for the adventures ahead!

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from jet lag. After waking, take a leisurely stroll along the beachfront near Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the morning sea breeze and get your bearings around the local area. Visit a nearby local fresh market to sample tropical fruits like mango, papaya, and rambutan (budget ~50-100 THB).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local beach area — rent a beach chair (50-100 THB) and take a dip in the ocean. Walk along the shoreline and discover nearby beach shacks and local vendors. Visit a nearby temple or cultural landmark within walking distance of the resort to get a feel for Thai culture.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the nearest night market or walking street for dinner and exploration. Browse street food stalls, try local snacks, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere. Pick up some souvenirs if you like.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast if included, or visit a local street stall for Jok (Thai rice porridge) or Khanom Pang Kai (Thai-style toast with egg) — budget ~60-80 THB.
meals.lunch: Street food lunch near the beach — try Pad Thai from a local vendor (~60-80 THB) or a fresh seafood dish at a beachside shack (~100-150 THB).
meals.dinner: Night market dinner — sample 3-4 dishes like grilled skewers, mango sticky rice, and a cold Thai iced tea (~150-200 THB total).

day_by_day.notes: October is during Thailand's rainy season in some regions — carry a small foldable umbrella. Stay hydrated and apply sunscreen. This is a relaxed orientation day — don't overplan.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise beach walk. Head to a local beachside café for breakfast. Rent a scooter or bicycle (~150-250 THB/day) to explore the local area independently. Visit a nearby viewpoint or hilltop for panoramic coastal views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore hidden coves and quieter beaches nearby by scooter or songthaew (shared red truck taxi, ~30-50 THB per ride). Spend time snorkeling at a calm beach spot — bring your own snorkel gear or rent it locally (~150-200 THB). Look for colorful fish and coral near the shoreline.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort area and freshen up. Head out for a beachside dinner as the sun sets. Try fresh grilled seafood at a local beachfront restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Beachside café — smoothie bowl or Thai-style eggs with toast (~80-120 THB).
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic from a local market — fresh fruit, sticky rice, and grilled chicken (~80-100 THB).
meals.dinner: Beachfront seafood grill — grilled fish, prawns, and som tam (papaya salad) with steamed rice (~200-250 THB).

day_by_day.notes: When renting a scooter, always wear a helmet and carry your passport or a copy. Check that the scooter is in good condition before renting. Negotiate rental prices if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget island-hopping day tour (book through a local guesthouse or tour agent, ~600-900 THB per person). Depart by longtail boat to visit nearby islands. First stop: a secluded island with crystal-clear water and white sand beaches for swimming and snorkeling.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue island hopping — visit a second island known for its dramatic limestone cliffs or vibrant coral reefs. Enjoy a packed lunch on the boat or at a beach shack on the island. Snorkel around coral gardens and look for sea turtles, rays, and tropical fish.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the mainland by late afternoon. Shower and relax at the resort. Head out for a casual dinner and enjoy a Thai massage to soothe tired muscles (~200-300 THB for 1 hour at a local parlor).

meals.breakfast: Early street food breakfast before departure — Khao Tom (rice soup) or fried rice (~60 THB).
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included in tour or buy from island beach shack — grilled corn, fruit, and water (~100 THB).
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant near the resort — green curry with jasmine rice and a Chang beer (~180-220 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Book island-hopping tours the day before to secure a spot. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a dry bag for your phone, and plenty of water. October seas can be choppy — take motion sickness tablets if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Take a half-day cooking class at a local Thai cooking school (~500-800 THB). Learn to make 3-4 classic Thai dishes including Pad Thai, Tom Yum soup, and Thai green curry. This is a hands-on, budget-friendly cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cooking class, explore a nearby local market or fishing village. Watch fishermen bring in their daily catch and interact with locals. Visit a Buddhist temple in the area — dress respectfully (cover shoulders and knees). Admire intricate architecture and golden Buddha statues.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the dishes you cooked for lunch or an early dinner. Spend the evening at a beachside bar watching the sunset with a cheap local beer (Chang or Leo, ~60-80 THB) or a fresh coconut (~40 THB).

meals.breakfast: Street food stall — Khanom Krok (coconut pancakes) or Rotee (Thai-style flatbread with banana and condensed milk) (~50-70 THB).
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you prepared in the cooking class (usually included in the class fee).
meals.dinner: Light dinner at a beachside bar — spring rolls, satay skewers, and a cold drink (~150-180 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Cooking classes are a great budget activity — you learn a skill and get a meal. Book in advance as spots fill up. Bring a notebook to write down recipes to recreate at home.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day — take a ferry or speedboat to a nearby island (e.g., Koh Tao, Koh Phangan, or Koh Lanta depending on your base location). Book tickets in advance through a local agent (~300-600 THB). Enjoy the scenic boat ride and spot flying fish along the way.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at the new island and check in to a budget guesthouse or hostel (~300-500 THB/night). Explore the main beach and town area on foot. Rent a scooter to scout the island and find your favorite beach spots.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the island's night scene — visit a beachfront bar with fire shows (common on Koh Phangan), or relax at a quiet beach bar with live acoustic music. Sample the local street food scene.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the pier before departure — fried rice or noodle soup (~60-80 THB).
meals.lunch: Grab food on the ferry or at the arrival pier — sandwiches, fruit, or instant noodles (~50-80 THB).
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant on the new island — massaman curry with rice, fresh juice (~180-220 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Keep your luggage light and use a small daypack for ferry travel. Lock valuables in the guesthouse safe. Check ferry schedules the night before as they can change due to weather in October.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise snorkeling or diving session at a renowned snorkel spot on the island (guided snorkel tour ~400-600 THB, or explore independently with rented gear ~150 THB). Look for whale sharks, sea turtles, and vibrant coral (especially near Koh Tao).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hike to a scenic island viewpoint — most islands have a short 30-60 minute hike to a hilltop with panoramic ocean views. Bring water and wear comfortable shoes. Relax at a secluded beach discovered during the hike.
day_by_day.evening: Join a communal dinner at a beachfront hostel or guesthouse — great for meeting fellow budget travelers. Share stories and plan future activities together. Try a bucket cocktail (a Thai beach staple, ~150-200 THB) if you drink.

meals.breakfast: Hostel breakfast or local café — banana pancakes (a backpacker staple, ~60-80 THB) and fresh fruit shake.
meals.lunch: Beachside shack — grilled fish with rice and a coconut (~120-150 THB).
meals.dinner: Communal hostel BBQ or local restaurant — mixed Thai dishes shared family-style (~150-200 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Stay hydrated during hikes — bring at least 1 liter of water. Wear reef-safe sunscreen for snorkeling. If you're interested in scuba diving, Koh Tao offers some of the world's cheapest PADI Open Water courses (~9,000-10,000 THB for 3-4 days).

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning at the most beautiful beach on the island — arrive early to beat the crowds. Swim, read, or simply relax and enjoy the natural beauty. Collect shells and explore tide pools at low tide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a kayak (~150-200 THB/hour) and paddle along the coastline, exploring sea caves, hidden lagoons, and mangrove channels. This is a fantastic low-cost adventure activity with stunning scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from a clifftop bar or beach. Enjoy a fresh fruit smoothie or a cold beer. Head to the local night market for dinner and browse handicraft stalls for affordable souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Beach café — açaí bowl or yogurt with granola and tropical fruit (~80-120 THB).
meals.lunch: Beachside vendor — grilled corn, mango salad, and fresh coconut water (~80-100 THB).
meals.dinner: Night market feast — pad see ew noodles, fish cakes, mango sticky rice, and Thai iced coffee (~150-200 THB).

day_by_day.notes: October can bring afternoon rain showers — plan outdoor activities for the morning. Kayaking is best done in calm morning waters. Always wear a life jacket when kayaking.

day_by_day.morning: Travel back to the mainland or to a new island destination by ferry. Enjoy the journey and the changing scenery. Upon arrival, explore a new coastal town or beach area. Visit a local fresh seafood market at the pier.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a famous local attraction in the area — this could be a national park, a waterfall accessible by songthaew, or a historic temple complex. Entry fees for national parks are typically ~200 THB for foreigners. Explore jungle trails and swim in natural pools.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a new budget accommodation. Explore the local area on foot. Find a popular local restaurant recommended by guesthouse staff for an authentic Thai dinner experience.

meals.breakfast: Ferry pier breakfast — Khanom Jeen (fermented rice noodles with curry) or congee (~60-80 THB).
meals.lunch: Waterfall or national park picnic — buy supplies from a local market beforehand (~80-100 THB).
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant recommended by locals — try regional specialties like Gaeng Som (sour curry) or Khao Yam (southern Thai rice salad) (~150-200 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Ask your guesthouse for insider tips on the best local spots — they often know hidden gems that aren't in guidebooks. Avoid tourist traps by eating where locals eat.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a famous viewpoint or landmark in the area — such as a karst limestone cliff, a sacred cave temple, or a traditional fishing village. Many of these attractions are free or very low cost. Hire a longtail boat for a private tour (~500-800 THB split between a group).
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at a stunning beach known for its emerald waters. Snorkel, swim, or simply sunbathe. Try stand-up paddleboarding if available (~200-300 THB/hour). Explore the beach on foot and discover quieter corners.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free Muay Thai boxing match if available in the area (free or low-cost local events, ~100-200 THB for tourist venues). This is an exciting cultural experience unique to Thailand.

meals.breakfast: Local market breakfast — Khao Niao Mamuang (mango sticky rice) and fresh fruit (~60-80 THB).
meals.lunch: Beachside restaurant — tom kha gai (coconut milk soup) with rice (~120-150 THB).
meals.dinner: Street food dinner near the Muay Thai venue — grilled pork skewers, papaya salad, and sticky rice (~150 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Muay Thai events are a highlight of Thai culture — even if you're not into sports, the atmosphere is electric. Check with your guesthouse for schedules. Longtail boat tours are best negotiated directly with boat operators at the pier.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a street food tour — either self-guided or with a local guide (~500-700 THB for guided tours). Visit a wet market, sample regional dishes, and learn about Thai ingredients and cooking methods. Try dishes you haven't eaten yet.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local handicraft or artisan market. Browse handmade goods, silk scarves, wooden carvings, and local art. Practice your bargaining skills — it's expected and part of the culture. Pick up gifts and souvenirs within budget.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourself to a special budget-friendly dinner at a well-reviewed local restaurant. Splurge slightly on a fresh seafood platter or a Thai set menu. Enjoy a relaxed evening stroll along the beach under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Street food tour breakfast — multiple small bites including Sai Krok Isan (fermented sausage), fried banana, and Num Toey (pandan drink) (~100-150 THB total).
meals.lunch: Street food tour lunch — included in tour or buy from market stalls (~80-120 THB).
meals.dinner: Slightly splurge dinner — fresh seafood platter with steamed rice, tom yum soup, and dessert (~300-400 THB — still very budget-friendly!).

day_by_day.notes: When bargaining at markets, start at 50-60% of the asking price and negotiate up. Always smile and be friendly — aggressive bargaining is frowned upon. Don't buy items made from endangered animals or coral.

day_by_day.morning: Final island or beach exploration day. Revisit your favorite beach or discover one you haven't been to yet. Go for a long morning swim or try a new water activity like wakeboarding or parasailing (~500-800 THB) as a farewell treat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack up and do any last-minute shopping. Visit a pharmacy to stock up on affordable Thai products like Tiger Balm, herbal remedies, and skincare. Head to a local tailor if interested in custom-made clothing (~500-1,500 THB for a custom shirt or dress).
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner with fellow travelers you've met along the way. Choose a beachfront restaurant with great ambiance. Watch the sunset one last time over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand. Reflect on the amazing 12 days of adventure.

meals.breakfast: Hotel or guesthouse breakfast — or a final visit to your favorite local breakfast spot (~60-80 THB).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at a beach café — fresh spring rolls, fruit smoothie, and coconut ice cream (~100-130 THB).
meals.dinner: Farewell beachfront dinner — order a variety of Thai classics to share: Pad Thai, green curry, som tam, and sticky rice with mango for dessert (~250-350 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Start packing tonight if your flight is early tomorrow. Keep essentials in your carry-on. Exchange leftover Thai Baht back to your home currency at the airport (rates are slightly lower but convenient).

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for final preparations and checkout. Take a last stroll along the beach to soak in the atmosphere. Grab a final Thai breakfast from a street stall near the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Travel to the nearest airport or ferry terminal for your onward journey. Allow plenty of time for transfers — Thai traffic can be unpredictable. Check in online if possible to save time. Browse airport duty-free shops for last-minute Thai snacks (dried mango, coconut chips) to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with incredible memories of beaches, islands, and street food adventures. Review your budget, organize your photos, and start planning your next trip!

meals.breakfast: Final Thai street food breakfast — Khao Man Gai (poached chicken with rice) or Pad Kra Pao (Thai basil stir-fry) (~60-80 THB).
meals.lunch: Airport food court — surprisingly affordable with local Thai options (~120-180 THB).
meals.dinner: On the plane or at a transit airport.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2-3 hours before international flights. Keep all receipts for VAT refund claims (7% VAT refund available at the airport for purchases over 2,000 THB from participating shops). Thailand has a 300 THB departure tax included in most international tickets. Safe travels!

trip_options.title: Classic Thailand Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled – flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled – in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi or Phuket Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange pre-booked airport transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and get oriented with the resort facilities.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a 7-Eleven or airport food court near your arrival terminal – try a Thai-style rice dish or noodle cup to get your first taste of local flavors

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – arrival is late at night. Confirm transfer in advance. Exchange some currency (THB) at the airport for small expenses. Rest well for the adventures ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast. After settling in, take a relaxed stroll along the beachfront outside Aegean Bliss Resort to get your bearings. Dip your toes in the sea and soak up the surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a scooter or take a local songthaew (shared taxi) to explore the nearest beach town. Visit a local market or walking street to browse handicrafts, fresh tropical fruits, and souvenirs. Stop at a nearby viewpoint for scenic photos.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the nearest night market or beach-side street food strip. Sample classic Thai street food and enjoy the lively atmosphere with locals and travelers alike.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet – enjoy fresh tropical fruits, congee, and Thai-style eggs
meals.lunch: Local restaurant near the beach – try Pad Thai or Khao Man Gai (chicken rice) for around 80–120 THB
meals.dinner: Night market street food – sample Moo Ping (grilled pork skewers), Som Tum (papaya salad), and Mango Sticky Rice for under 200 THB total

day_by_day.notes: October is in the tail end of the rainy season in some parts of Thailand – carry a light rain jacket. Stay hydrated and apply sunscreen before heading out.

day_by_day.morning: Join a half-day snorkeling or kayaking tour departing from the resort's nearest pier. Explore crystal-clear waters, coral reefs, and colorful marine life around nearby islets.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for lunch and a relaxed afternoon by the pool or beach. Take a long walk along the shoreline, collect shells, or simply read a book under a palm tree.
day_by_day.evening: Visit a beachfront restaurant for a sunset dinner with fresh seafood. Enjoy the golden hour views over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a local café – try Thai-style toast with pandan jam and iced Thai tea
meals.lunch: Resort restaurant or nearby beach shack – grilled fish with rice and a fresh coconut for around 150–200 THB
meals.dinner: Beachfront seafood restaurant – grilled prawns, steamed sea bass with lime and garlic, and jasmine rice for 300–500 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Book snorkeling tours at the resort's activity desk the evening before. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and an underwater camera or waterproof phone case.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day island hopping tour. Depart by speedboat to visit 3–4 surrounding islands, including a hidden lagoon, a sandbar, and a snorkeling spot teeming with tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island hopping tour – enjoy a packed lunch on a secluded beach, swim in turquoise waters, and explore sea caves or limestone karsts if available in the area.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the mainland by late afternoon. Shower and freshen up at the resort, then enjoy a quiet dinner at a local Thai restaurant in the nearby town.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before the boat departs – grab a banana and a coffee to go
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included with the island hopping tour, typically simple Thai rice boxes eaten on the beach
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant in town – try Green Curry (Gaeng Keow Wan), Pad Kra Pao (basil stir-fry), and steamed rice for 150–250 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Island hopping tours typically cost 800–1,500 THB per person for a full day. Book through the resort or a reputable local operator. Bring seasickness tablets if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Take a tuk-tuk or songthaew to the nearest town for a street food breakfast tour. Visit a fresh morning market (Talat Sot) to sample local specialties like Jok (rice porridge), Khanom Krok (coconut pancakes), and fresh-cut fruit.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby cultural or natural attraction – a Buddhist temple (Wat), a viewpoint hill, or a mangrove forest walk depending on your resort's location. Hire a local guide for deeper context.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort area for a relaxed evening. Walk the beachfront promenade, browse souvenir shops, and enjoy a casual dinner at a mid-range Thai eatery.

meals.breakfast: Morning market street food crawl – budget 100–150 THB for a full spread of local snacks and drinks
meals.lunch: Local restaurant near the temple or attraction – try Khao Soi (northern-style curry noodles) or Tom Yum soup with rice
meals.dinner: Mid-range Thai restaurant – Massaman Curry, fresh spring rolls, and Thai iced tea for 200–350 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting temples – cover shoulders and knees. Remove shoes before entering temple buildings. Carry small change for market purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Take a ferry or speedboat transfer to a nearby major island (e.g., Koh Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Tao, or Koh Samui depending on your base). Check into a mid-range guesthouse or boutique hotel for a 2-night stay.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the island's main village on foot. Visit the local market, rent a bicycle, or simply wander the colorful streets. Head to a viewpoint for panoramic island views.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the island's famous beach bar scene or a fire show performance (common on Koh Phi Phi and Koh Samui). Dine at a lively beachside restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before departure – or grab something at the ferry pier
meals.lunch: Island café or restaurant upon arrival – fresh fruit smoothie bowl or a simple Pad See Ew for 100–150 THB
meals.dinner: Beach restaurant on the island – BBQ seafood platter, sticky rice, and fresh fruit juice for 350–500 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Ferry schedules vary by season – book tickets in advance or through your resort. October seas can be choppy; larger ferries are more stable than longtail boats for open-water crossings.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise hike to the island's most famous viewpoint. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding islands and sea before the crowds arrive.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the island's most beautiful beach. Swim, snorkel, or simply relax on the white sand. Rent a kayak to paddle around nearby rock formations or sea caves.
day_by_day.evening: Join a sunset cruise or longtail boat trip around the island for golden hour views. Return to the village for dinner and a stroll through the night market.

meals.breakfast: Street food near the viewpoint trail – grilled corn, fresh coconut water, and Thai-style fried dough (Pa Thong Ko) for under 80 THB
meals.lunch: Beach shack lunch – grilled fish with som tum and rice, washed down with a cold Chang beer or coconut water for 150–200 THB
meals.dinner: Island night market – sample various stalls for Satay skewers, Pad Thai, fresh oysters, and Thai desserts for 200–300 THB total

day_by_day.notes: The viewpoint hike can be steep and slippery after rain – wear proper footwear. Start the hike before 7:00 AM to beat the heat and crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning ferry back to the mainland or your base resort. Enjoy the scenic sea journey and arrive refreshed. Check back into Aegean Bliss Resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax and recharge at the resort's pool or beachfront. Treat yourself to a traditional Thai massage at a local spa near the resort (90-minute session costs 400–600 THB at a reputable mid-range spa).
day_by_day.evening: Explore the local area on a self-guided street food walk. Visit a hawker-style food court or a bustling street lined with food carts for a casual, authentic dinner experience.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the ferry pier before departure – rice soup or a pastry and coffee
meals.lunch: Resort restaurant upon return – treat yourself to a light meal like a fresh papaya salad and grilled chicken
meals.dinner: Street food walk – try Boat Noodles (Kuay Teow Reua), Crispy Pork Rice, and Thai Milk Tea from different stalls for 150–250 THB total

day_by_day.notes: Book your Thai massage in advance if possible, especially during peak hours (late afternoon). Choose licensed massage shops with clean facilities.

day_by_day.morning: Join a cooking class at a local Thai cooking school. Learn to prepare 3–4 classic Thai dishes including a curry paste from scratch, a stir-fry, and a dessert. Classes typically run 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the cooking class (which includes lunch), visit a nearby floating market or local pier market to see how fresh ingredients are sold and traded. Pick up some local spices or condiments as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Head to a rooftop bar or elevated restaurant for sundowner cocktails and dinner with a view. Splurge slightly on a nicer sit-down meal as a mid-trip treat.

meals.breakfast: Local café breakfast before the cooking class – Thai-style omelet with rice or toast with condensed milk for 60–100 THB
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you cooked during the cooking class – this is included in the class fee (typically 1,000–1,500 THB for the full experience)
meals.dinner: Rooftop or elevated restaurant – Tom Kha Gai soup, Panang Curry, jasmine rice, and a cocktail for 400–600 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Cooking classes are a highlight of any Thailand trip. Book in advance as popular classes fill up quickly. You'll receive a recipe booklet to recreate dishes at home.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to a second island or a more remote beach accessible by longtail boat. Enjoy a quieter, less-touristed stretch of sand and pristine water away from the crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel or free-dive at a coral-rich spot near the day-trip island. Look for clownfish, sea turtles, and reef sharks in the clear waters. Relax on the beach before the return boat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a casual beachside dinner at a simple local restaurant, watching the stars come out over the sea.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Pack your own lunch from a local bakery or market, or buy from a small vendor on the day-trip island – fresh fruit, sandwiches, or rice boxes
meals.dinner: Simple beachside restaurant – Fried Rice with seafood, Tom Yum soup, and fresh fruit for 200–300 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Day trips to remote beaches or islands can be arranged through the resort or local tour operators for 500–1,000 THB per person including boat transfer. Bring plenty of water and snacks.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local elephant sanctuary or wildlife conservation center if available in your region (ethical sanctuaries where elephants roam freely, no riding). Morning sessions typically run 3–4 hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the sanctuary visit, stop at a roadside local restaurant for lunch. Spend the afternoon exploring a nearby town's cultural district, visiting a Wat (temple complex), and browsing local artisan shops.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort area for a relaxed final evening. Enjoy a beachfront dinner and a sunset walk along the shore.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before heading out
meals.lunch: Roadside local restaurant near the sanctuary – Khao Pad (fried rice) or Laab (spicy minced meat salad) for 80–120 THB
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant – whole grilled fish, morning glory stir-fry, and sticky rice for 300–450 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Choose only ethical elephant sanctuaries certified by Elephant Nature Park or similar organizations. Avoid any venue offering elephant riding or shows. Book well in advance as spots are limited.

day_by_day.morning: Spend your last full morning revisiting your favorite beach or spot near the resort. Take a final swim, collect a few shells as mementos, and enjoy a slow, peaceful breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Do last-minute souvenir shopping at a local market or artisan shop. Pick up Thai spices, handmade silk scarves, coconut oil products, or local artwork. Pack your bags and organize belongings.
day_by_day.evening: Treat yourself to a farewell dinner at one of the best restaurants in the area. Splurge on a multi-course Thai meal with fresh seafood, signature curries, and a dessert platter.

meals.breakfast: Slow resort breakfast – enjoy every last bite of tropical fruits, Thai pastries, and strong Thai coffee
meals.lunch: Street food lunch at a local market – one last round of your favorite Thai street food dishes for 150–200 THB
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a top-rated local restaurant – Chef's tasting menu or a la carte with signature dishes, cocktails, and dessert for 600–900 THB per person

day_by_day.notes: Keep receipts for VAT refund claims at the airport if you spent over 2,000 THB at eligible shops. Confirm your departure transfer for the next morning.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early depending on your departure flight time. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort. Complete checkout formalities and load luggage into your pre-arranged airport transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Travel to the airport. Arrive at least 2–3 hours before your international departure. Browse duty-free shops for last-minute Thai snacks, jasmine rice crackers, or elephant-themed gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Reflect on 13 incredible days of beaches, island hopping, and street food adventures across Thailand.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or a grab-and-go meal from a convenience store near the resort
meals.lunch: Airport food court or restaurant – one last bowl of Tom Yum noodles or Pad Thai before flying home
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport lounge dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow extra time for airport check-in and security. Keep important documents (passport, boarding pass, travel insurance) easily accessible. Declare any food items to customs if required by your home country.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Thailand Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at destination airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Private luxury transfer arranged to Aegean Bliss Resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a warm welcome with traditional Thai garland greeting, chilled towels, and a complimentary welcome drink at the resort. Check in to your beachfront suite and unwind on your private terrace listening to the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Light late-night in-room dining from the resort's 24-hour menu — recommend the Tom Kha Gai soup, fresh spring rolls, and a chilled Singha beer or mocktail to ease into Thailand

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange airport transfer with the resort concierge before travel. Request early check-in amenities and a chilled fruit platter in the room upon arrival. Keep Day 1 light — rest is the priority.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take a sunrise stroll along the private beachfront of Aegean Bliss Resort. Explore the resort grounds, take a dip in the infinity pool, and enjoy a full resort breakfast with panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation afternoon — take a private guided tuk-tuk or resort shuttle tour of the nearby local village and beach town. Discover the local market scene, browse artisan stalls, and get acquainted with the neighborhood. Visit a nearby beachside viewpoint for stunning coastal vistas.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's beachfront bar. Enjoy a private beachside dinner under the stars arranged by the resort — a curated Thai tasting menu with fresh seafood grilled tableside on the sand.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet at the Aegean Bliss Resort main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs benedict, Thai congee, fresh-pressed juices, and artisan coffee
meals.lunch: Casual poolside lunch at the resort — grilled tiger prawns, papaya salad, and coconut water served in a fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Private beachside dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — 5-course Thai tasting menu featuring fresh lobster, sea bass in banana leaf, and mango sticky rice for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to fully recover from travel and orient yourself. Speak with the resort concierge to confirm all upcoming excursions and island-hopping bookings for the week ahead.

day_by_day.morning: Private longtail boat excursion departing from the resort's beach at 8:00 AM. Explore hidden sea caves, emerald lagoons, and limestone karst formations along the coastline. Snorkeling stop at a pristine coral reef with complimentary gear provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Island hop to a nearby secluded island for a private beach picnic lunch. Explore the island on foot, swim in crystal-clear turquoise waters, and relax in a hammock strung between palm trees. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Visit a renowned local fine-dining restaurant near the resort known for elevated Thai cuisine. Explore the nearby beach promenade for a post-dinner evening walk and browse local artisan night market stalls.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, croissants, and strong Thai iced coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet private beach picnic on the secluded island — curated by the resort with charcuterie, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, artisan bread, and chilled rosé wine
meals.dinner: Dinner at a premium local Thai restaurant — order the signature whole steamed fish with lime and chili, massaman lamb curry, and jasmine rice; pair with fresh coconut mojitos

day_by_day.notes: Apply high-SPF reef-safe sunscreen. Bring a dry bag for electronics on the boat. October weather may include brief tropical showers — the boat captain will navigate accordingly. Confirm departure time with concierge the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the beach arranged by the resort (6:30 AM). Followed by a traditional Thai herbal steam and massage at the resort's luxury spa — book the 90-minute 'Royal Thai Ritual' package for a full rejuvenating experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private cooking class with a celebrated local Thai chef held at a premium culinary studio near the resort. Learn to prepare 4 classic Thai dishes including Pad Thai, green curry, tom yum soup, and mango sticky rice. Take home a recipe card booklet.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private rooftop dinner experience with panoramic ocean views. Enjoy the dishes you learned to make earlier, prepared by the resort chef using your recipes as inspiration, elevated with premium ingredients.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga smoothie bowls and a light healthy breakfast at the resort's wellness café — acai bowls, chia pudding, fresh coconut, and green juices
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you prepared during the cooking class — a full Thai feast enjoyed at the culinary studio with your instructor and fellow guests
meals.dinner: Rooftop private dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort — personalized menu inspired by your cooking class, with premium wine pairing curated by the resort sommelier

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa in advance as slots fill quickly. The cooking class typically runs 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Inform the culinary studio of any dietary restrictions when booking. Wear comfortable, light clothing for the cooking class.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day island hopping adventure begins at 7:30 AM. Board a private chartered speedboat for a premium island-hopping tour. First stop: a famous snorkeling island with vibrant coral gardens and tropical fish. Explore underwater with provided premium snorkeling gear.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to a stunning phi phi-style island with dramatic cliffs and turquoise bays. Kayak through sea caves and mangrove channels. Enjoy a floating lunch on the boat deck anchored in a secluded bay. Swim off the back of the boat in glassy, warm water.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort by 5:30 PM. Freshen up and head to a celebrated beachfront seafood restaurant for dinner. Enjoy the catch of the day grilled over charcoal with panoramic sunset views over the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — eggs your way, Thai rice porridge, fresh fruit platter, and strong espresso before departure
meals.lunch: Floating gourmet lunch on the private charter boat — fresh sashimi, grilled prawns, Thai salads, cold cuts, tropical fruit, and premium beverages
meals.dinner: Dinner at a top-rated beachfront seafood restaurant — grilled whole red snapper, garlic butter crab claws, spicy seafood fried rice, and fresh coconut ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Full-day trip — pack sunscreen, a hat, sunglasses, and a change of clothes. Bring motion sickness tablets if needed. The private charter includes a captain, crew, snorkeling gear, kayaks, and a cooler stocked with drinks. Confirm booking 48 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning at the resort. Enjoy a slow breakfast and then explore the resort's private beach cove. Rent a stand-up paddleboard or kayak from the resort beach shack and paddle along the coastline at your own pace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided cultural excursion to a nearby ornate Buddhist temple complex. Learn about Thai Buddhist traditions, participate in a merit-making ceremony, and receive a blessing from a monk. Explore the temple grounds and surrounding local village.
day_by_day.evening: Street food tour in the nearest town or night market — a curated premium guided experience with a local food expert. Sample 8-10 signature Thai street food dishes including satay, pad see ew, roti with condensed milk, and fresh mango sticky rice from legendary local vendors.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast on your private terrace — room service with fresh tropical fruit, eggs, pastries, and Thai tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at a highly regarded local restaurant near the temple — authentic khao man gai (Hainanese chicken rice), crispy pork belly, and cold Thai iced tea
meals.dinner: Premium street food tour — guided tasting of 8-10 dishes across multiple legendary vendors at the night market; budget approximately 500-800 THB per person for tastings plus premium drinks

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly for temple visit — cover shoulders and knees. Bring a sarong or lightweight scarf. The street food tour typically starts at 6:30 PM and lasts 2.5 hours. Book through the concierge for a vetted premium food guide experience.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint rest and indulgence day. Sleep in and enjoy a late breakfast. Spend the morning at the resort's luxury pool complex — reserve a private cabana with bottle service and personal pool attendant. Read, relax, and recharge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Full luxury spa afternoon at the Aegean Bliss Resort spa. Book the 'Thai Heritage Journey' — a 3-hour premium spa package including a traditional Thai massage, aromatic oil massage, herbal compress treatment, and a rejuvenating facial using local botanical ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner cocktails at the resort's overwater bar. Celebrate the midpoint of the trip with a bottle of Champagne on the beach. Dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — a modern Thai cuisine tasting menu with wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent late breakfast in bed — French press coffee, eggs benedict with smoked salmon, fresh-cut tropical fruit tower, and freshly baked pastries delivered by room service
meals.lunch: Light poolside grazing — premium sushi platter, edamame, miso soup, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Signature restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — 7-course modern Thai tasting menu with optional premium wine pairing; highlights include wagyu beef massaman and lobster tom yum

day_by_day.notes: This is your recovery and luxury indulgence day — no rushing. Pre-book the spa package at least 2 days in advance. The resort's signature restaurant may require a reservation — confirm with concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure for a premium day trip to a famous nearby national marine park. Board a private speedboat at 7:00 AM. Explore pristine protected waters, snorkel over untouched coral reefs, and spot exotic marine life including sea turtles and reef sharks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Picnic lunch on a deserted white-sand beach within the marine park. Hike a short nature trail through tropical jungle to a hidden viewpoint overlooking the archipelago. Swim in a secluded natural pool. Return to resort by 5:00 PM.
day_by_day.evening: Casual evening at the resort — enjoy a sunset swim in the ocean, then dine at a relaxed but upscale beachfront restaurant within walking distance of the resort. Try traditional Southern Thai cuisine, which is known for being bolder and spicier.

meals.breakfast: Pre-departure resort breakfast — energy-boosting smoothie, avocado toast, scrambled eggs, and fresh juice
meals.lunch: Gourmet beach picnic on the marine park island — freshly prepared by the boat crew with artisan sandwiches, grilled chicken skewers, tropical fruit, and premium cold beverages
meals.dinner: Upscale beachfront restaurant near the resort — Southern Thai specialties including gaeng tai pla (fish curry), crab fried rice, and fresh grilled barracuda with chili lime sauce

day_by_day.notes: Marine park may have entry fees — typically 200-400 THB per person. Use reef-safe sunscreen only in protected waters. Bring waterproof camera or GoPro for underwater photography. Check marine park access with concierge as seasonal closures may apply.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided kayaking and paddleboarding session along the coastline with a certified water sports instructor from the resort. Explore sea caves, hidden coves, and mangrove forests accessible only by kayak. Morning ends with a beachside refreshment stop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby luxury beach club for the afternoon. Enjoy a reserved daybed on the deck, swim in their infinity pool, and enjoy premium cocktails and light bites while overlooking the ocean. A change of scenery from the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private in-villa dinner experience — the resort chef comes to your suite and prepares a personalized 4-course Thai dinner in your private space, served on your terrace with ocean views and candlelight.

meals.breakfast: Light resort breakfast before water sports — granola, yogurt, banana, and strong Thai coffee
meals.lunch: Premium beach club lunch — lobster roll, truffle fries, fresh oysters, and a signature cocktail or mocktail at the beach club bar
meals.dinner: Private in-villa dinner prepared by the resort chef — personalized 4-course menu; recommend starting with tom yum prawn soup, followed by green papaya salad, grilled sea bass with lemongrass, and coconut panna cotta for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Book the private in-villa dining experience at least 2 days in advance through the concierge. The beach club may require a minimum spend — confirm details before visiting. Water sports session is best in the morning when seas are typically calmer.

day_by_day.morning: Take a private longtail boat to a nearby floating village or fishing community for an authentic cultural immersion experience. Meet local fishermen, learn about traditional fishing techniques, and explore the stilted wooden village on foot.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a renowned local artisan workshop where traditional Thai crafts are made — silk weaving, wood carving, or ceramic pottery depending on the region. Participate in a hands-on workshop and purchase premium handcrafted souvenirs directly from the artisans.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dinner cruise aboard a private chartered traditional Thai wooden boat. Sail along the coastline as the sun sets, enjoying canapés and Champagne. A private chef onboard prepares a 4-course dinner as you cruise under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full Thai breakfast with khao tom (rice soup), soft-boiled eggs, fresh fruit, and jasmine tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at a beloved local family-run restaurant in the fishing village — freshest catch of the day prepared simply with garlic and herbs, steamed rice, and cold Chang beer
meals.dinner: Private sunset dinner cruise — 4-course menu prepared onboard: amuse-bouche, prawn bisque, grilled lobster tail with herb butter, and a Thai-inspired chocolate lava cake with coconut ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The sunset dinner cruise typically departs 1 hour before sunset — confirm exact timing with concierge based on the date. Bring a light layer as it can be breezy on the water in the evening. This is an excellent occasion for photography — golden hour on the water is spectacular.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated beach morning — stake out a prime spot on the resort's private beach. Enjoy complimentary beach service with chilled towels, fresh fruit skewers, and cold drinks delivered to your lounger. Read, swim, and simply enjoy the paradise setting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange a private guided elephant sanctuary visit at an ethical, reputable sanctuary within day-trip distance. Interact with rescued elephants, feed them, bathe them in the river, and learn about elephant conservation in Thailand from expert guides.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell penultimate premium evening — dinner at the most acclaimed fine-dining restaurant in the area, known for its fusion of Thai and international cuisine. This is the trip's most special dinner — dress to impress.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory resort brunch — eggs royale, smoked salmon bagels, mimosas, fresh-pressed juices, and a full pastry selection
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the elephant sanctuary — traditional Thai box lunch provided by the sanctuary including rice, stir-fried vegetables, and fresh fruit
meals.dinner: Premium fine-dining restaurant — signature tasting menu with 8 courses; highlights include foie gras with tamarind glaze, butter-poached lobster, and a deconstructed Thai dessert platter; full wine pairing recommended

day_by_day.notes: Only visit elephant sanctuaries that are certified ethical — no riding, no shows, only natural interaction. Book well in advance as spaces are limited. The fine-dining restaurant will require a reservation — book through the concierge at least 3 days ahead. Smart casual dress code at minimum.

day_by_day.morning: Final full morning — sunrise beach walk to collect memories and photographs. Visit the resort's gift shop for premium Thai souvenirs, locally made products, and artisan gifts. Pack non-essential items to prepare for departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Farewell spa treatment — book a 60-minute traditional Thai foot massage and aromatherapy session. Followed by a final swim in the resort's infinity pool with a cold cocktail in hand. Soak in every last moment of the luxury resort experience.
day_by_day.evening: Final dinner in Thailand — return to your favorite restaurant from the trip or try one last new experience. Choose a celebrated local street food area for a casual but memorable last supper, sampling all the Thai dishes you've come to love over the past 12 days.

meals.breakfast: Special farewell breakfast at the resort — order everything you loved most from the past 12 days; the chef will accommodate a personalized farewell breakfast menu upon request
meals.lunch: Poolside farewell lunch — premium seafood platter, fresh rolls, tropical fruit sorbet, and a final round of signature cocktails
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner — premium local seafood restaurant or revisit your favorite from the trip; end with a traditional Thai dessert sampler and a final Thai iced tea toast to the journey

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing this evening. Confirm departure transfer with the concierge. Request a late checkout if your flight allows. Leave gratuities for resort staff who made the trip exceptional — 500-1000 THB per key staff member is customary and appreciated.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy one last resort breakfast at a leisurely pace. Take a final walk on the beach to say goodbye to the ocean. Complete packing and prepare for checkout. Use the resort's luggage storage if you have a late transfer.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time — either a final relaxed poolside afternoon at the resort or an early private luxury transfer to the airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time for premium check-in and lounge access.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Thailand. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days of beaches, island hopping, street food adventures, and world-class luxury. Board your flight home carrying incredible memories, artisan souvenirs, and a deep appreciation for the Land of Smiles.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a quiet, savored last meal; fresh tropical fruit, Thai pastries, eggs, and a final perfect cup of Thai coffee
meals.lunch: Airport or lounge dining — access the premium airport lounge for a light meal before departure; alternatively, grab one last bowl of authentic Thai noodle soup from an airport restaurant
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport lounge dinner depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Confirm all bookings are settled and resort bill is reviewed before checkout. Keep one small bag accessible for airport essentials. Thailand departure tax is typically included in international airfare. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5-3 hours before an international departure. Safe travels!

query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026
